title: BEYOND CORRECTNESS: BENCHMARKING MULTI-DIMENSIONAL CODE GENERATION FOR LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the instruction-following (IF) rate of models when prompted to generate code using specific formatting or stylistic constraints (e.g., camel-case vs. snake-case naming conventions, specific line lengths, and for vs. while loop structures) to reveal inherent stylistic preferences learned from training data.
